notes.title: Update March 2016!
notes.content:
We’ve pushed up another update to the game! Once again we’ve taken any feedback into consideration and tweaked the game to address the concerns. Lots of fixes to the later levels and game wide tweaks to the spawning and AI of the Orcs.
Update list:
•	Fixed some AI issues with the Orcs
•	Fixed some more spawning issues
•	Fixed a bunch of minor bugs
•	More explosive barrels!
•	More pickups!
•	A few graphical tweaks
•	Collision improvements and other level tweaks

notes.title: Updates!
notes.content:
First off a big thanks to everyone who purchased and reviewed Orc Slayer! A lot of your feedback has really helped us to work on delivering a better game for you all :)

We've made some changes with more planned for the near future. Most of the changes are to the core gameplay. Some nice graphical updates, new ways to slay and a few bug fixes mean there has never been a better time to get slaying some orcs!

List of updates:

     UI fixes!
     New special bolt graphics!
     New hyperspeed weapon!
     Orc AI fixes/Tweaks!
     New Orc projectiles!
     Explosive barrels! 
     Reduced amount of Orcs on early levels!
     Reduced number of spawn towers on early levels!
 

http://s7.postimg.org/uhzgmbvyj/announce_image.png
